section.name: Apache Tomcat 6.x vulnerabilities
section.p: This page lists all security vulnerabilities fixed in released versions of Apache Tomcat 6.x. Each vulnerability is given a security impact rating by the Apache Tomcat security team - please note that this rating may vary from platform to platform. We also list the versions of Apache Tomcat the flaw is known to affect, and where a flaw has not been verified list the version with a question mark.
This page has been created from a review of the Apache Tomcat archives and the CVE list. Please send comments or corrections for these vulnerabilities to the Tomcat Security Team.
